comment: MTG_BP_NEW_ONLY_DEMOTE (docs/design/bp-empty-arm-deferred-site.md; board from the 2026-10-14 Mirrorwing cast-order draft). Zada + Goblin Instigator + Frontline Heroism: every trick leaves a Soldier the next fan copies onto, so the ORDER of two tricks decides which gets the extra payload. Ancestral Anger -> Oracle's Restoration -> Fortifying Draught deals 88; Oracle first deals 82. Oracle and Anger tie in the cast order and the tie falls to hand order, which lists Oracle first here, so the sibling {Anger, Oracle, Draught} casts Oracle first. The 88 line is 'Anger alone, then Oracle + Draught at its breakpoint' -- an old-cards-only continuation MTG_BP_NEW_ONLY deleted as that sibling's duplicate, so it was unreachable even at budget 0. Demoted to the walker's last wave it is found. Control: MTG_BP_NEW_ONLY_DEMOTE=0 must give no win (opponent at 84).
